'''Dolo Karenzi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] after the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FOTJ: Conviction" />
